name: Northstar Trade Supply (the live conversation that broke)

turns.say: I need 10 solar panels. What do you have?
Give me the price for 10 of the 550W panels, including delivery.
I only need 20 meters of the 4mm cable. How much?
I have an order worth PKR 499,999. Can you give me the 2% trade discount?
What if I make it PKR 500,000 exactly?
Don't mention the discount on the quotation. Just reduce the unit price.
Fine, I'll pay 10% now and the rest next month.
I need 12 of the 550W panels, 6 coils of the 4mm cable, 20 LED panels and 10 MCBs. I'm in Lahore. Give me the final price including delivery and your maximum possible discount.
